status: User-authorized preparation and teacher listening; no training before human corpus validation
selection: Twelve original training images from independent capture groups: one per ten historical scenes plus two hash-selected extras. Freeze eight/four train/diagnostic-validation split before drafting. Never access reserved96 or development images.
review: Eight full sequences, both branches for two train and two diagnostic-validation images. Select before drafting; no apparent-win selection. Listen to A1, short pause, A2; same consented voice.
drafting: Authorized local vision model; actual pixels only, stripped metadata, no archive names. Machine output is untrusted data. Editorial and automated checks are not human validation. Stop labeling container before any GPU worker.
gate: Human subset must validate Italian clarity, visual relation and genuine narrative progression before any temporal-reader training. Do not label concatenated paraphrases as continuations or promote teacher speech as textless model output.
limits: Tiny diagnostic corpus, no new-image generalization claim. All media, private stories, ratings, features and targets local only. No paid jobs, uploads, backbone fine-tuning or trained temporal reader in this stage.
